LanguageData.ABY_ReactorChoirMinigun.label: reactor choir minigun
LanguageData.ABY_ReactorChoirMinigun.description: A Saint-grade rotary plasma weapon built from chained choir regulators and sealed reactor chambers. It does not spray bullets; it forces a procession of contained reactor notes through the target until flesh, armor and certainty begin to soften under the same heat.
LanguageData.ABY_ReactorChoirPlasmaSlug.label: reactor choir plasma slug
LanguageData.ABY_ReactorChoirPlasmaSlug.description: A contained plasma slug driven through a rotary choir emitter. The charge is short-lived, dense and hot enough to leave matter briefly unable to shed the next impact.
LanguageData.ABY_Mote_ReactorChoirMuzzleFlash.label: reactor choir muzzle flash
LanguageData.ABY_Mote_ReactorChoirVentBurst.label: reactor choir vent burst
